# --instructions--

Escribe una función `dedupe` que reciba un array de cadenas (omite la etiqueta del argumento) y devuelva un nuevo array con los duplicados eliminados y los valores restantes en orden ascendente

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`dedupe(["b", "a", "b", "c", "a"])` debe devolver `["a", "b", "c"]`

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe(["b", "a", "b", "c", "a"]) == ["a", "b", "c"])
```

`dedupe(["x", "x", "x"])` debe devolver `["x"]`

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe(["x", "x", "x"]) == ["x"])
```

`dedupe([])` debe devolver un array vacío

```swift
tryCatch(dedupe([]) == [])
```

La función debe devolver un array de cadenas

```swift
tryCatch(type(of: dedupe(["a"])) == [String].self)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func dedupe(_ items: [String]) -> [String] {
    return Set(items).sorted()
}
```
